description: Browse Plex libraries, media, playlists, playback history and active sessions; refresh metadata and mark watched items.

plex_new_library_item_trigger.description: Runs for each new library item in Plex. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields ratingKey, key, title, type, summary, addedAt, updatedAt, viewCount

plex_new_or_updated_library_item_trigger.description: Runs for each library item added or changed in Plex. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
